descriptions.description: Echinospartum is a genus of flowering plants in the family Fabaceae. It belongs to the subfamily Faboideae. It is possibly synonymous with Genista.

Echinospartum comprises the following species: Echinospartum boissieri (Spach) Rothm. subsp. boissieri (Spach) Rothm. subsp. webbii (Spach) Greuter & Burdet Echinospartum horridum (M. Vahl) Rothm. Echinospartum ibericum Rivas-Martínez, Sánchez-MataThe validity of Echinospartum ibericum is questionable. subsp. algibicum (Talavera & Aparicio) Rivas Mart. subsp. ibericum Rivas-Martínez, Sánchez-Mata Echinospartum lugdunense (Jord.)
